episode.title: What These Labels Mean
episode.tagline: Ideological labels can be damn confusing. What do we mean by liberal, conservative, socialist, nationalist, left, right? They even seem to mean different things to different people!
episode.about: In this episode, on popular demand, Amit and Ajay break down the meanings of some commonly used labels and isms.
